Built from v1's own screens. 17 became 21. The welcome comes first, with a two-minute tour cut from real recordings. Three chapters open with the app moving, and the free rate page is back as an advert. The PIN is the till's own keypad. Sign-in is a moment: the passkey scans on the device, Google and Microsoft open an account chooser, and the email code comes after. Desktop and phone throughout. Any CurrencyDesk ID opens it (try CD-YORK-7K42).

CurrencyDesk Service Agreement
Version 1.0 · effective on the day you go live

This agreement is between CurrencyDesk and the business named in your account. By opening your desk you accept it on that business's behalf and confirm you're authorised to do so.

1 · What you're getting

Access to the CurrencyDesk platform for the plan you selected, for as long as the account is in good standing. We may add, change or retire individual features; we won't materially reduce what your plan does without telling you first.

2 · Fees, billing and renewal

Your subscription starts when you go live and renews automatically each period until cancelled. Fees are charged to the card on file. ID verification is coming and is not billed yet. Setup services are one-time and non-refundable once delivered. Prices are exclusive of tax. We may change pricing with thirty days' notice, effective at your next renewal.

Promotional codes apply only to the subscription fee, for the stated period, on the plan they were issued against. If a payment fails we may retry, charge a backup card if you've added one, and suspend access if it stays unpaid.

3 · Cancellation and refunds

Cancel any time from your account; access continues to the end of the paid period. Fees already paid are not refunded except where the law requires it. We can suspend or close an account for non-payment, unlawful use, or a serious breach of this agreement.

4 · Compliance stays yours

This is the part that matters most. CurrencyDesk is software. It helps you watch thresholds, prepare reports and keep records — it does not file on your behalf and it is not compliance advice. You remain the registered money services business. You remain responsible for your registration, your reporting obligations, your record retention, and for reviewing and submitting anything the system prepares. Nothing here transfers a regulatory duty to us.

5 · Your data and your clients' data

Your records stay yours. You grant us the licence needed to host, process, back up and display them so the service works, and to have our processors do the same. We handle personal information under our Privacy Policy, which forms part of this agreement.

You confirm you have the right to give us any client information you enter, and that you'll collect and use it lawfully in your jurisdiction. We may use aggregated and de-identified data — data that cannot identify you, your business or your clients — to operate, secure and improve the service.

6 · Your account and your team

You're responsible for your credentials and for everything done under accounts you create for your team, including what they can see and do. Tell us promptly if you think an account has been compromised.

7 · Acceptable use

Don't use the service to break the law, to launder money, to evade sanctions, to store someone else's data without the right to, or to attack, reverse-engineer or resell the platform. Don't misrepresent rates or records you produce with it.

8 · Early access

If you're on an early-access or founding plan, you understand the platform is still being built. Features may change, break, or be withdrawn. In exchange for preferential pricing you agree we may contact you for feedback, and that feedback you give us can be used to improve the product without obligation or payment. Any founding rate we've confirmed in writing is held for the life of that account.

9 · Availability and warranties

We work hard to keep the desk up, but the service is provided "as is" and "as available". To the fullest extent the law allows, we disclaim implied warranties of merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement. We don't warrant that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or that it will make you compliant.

10 · Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent the law allows, neither party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, or for lost profits, lost business, lost data or regulatory penalties. Our total liability for any claim is capped at the fees you paid us in the twelve months before the claim arose. Some jurisdictions don't allow these limits; where that's so, they apply to the extent permitted.

11 · Indemnity

You'll defend and indemnify us against claims arising from your use of the service, your records, your clients, or your breach of this agreement or of the law that applies to your business.

12 · Third parties

The desk relies on third-party providers for things like payments, verification and rate data. Their terms govern their part, and we're not responsible for their acts or omissions.

13 · Intellectual property

The platform, its design and everything in it stays ours. You get a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use it while your account is active.

14 · Changes to this agreement

We may update these terms. For material changes we'll email the address on your account before they take effect. Continuing to use the service after that date means you accept the new version.

15 · Law and disputes

This agreement is governed by the laws of the Province of Ontario and the federal laws of Canada that apply there, and both parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Ontario. Claims must be brought individually, not as part of a class action. Before filing anything, talk to us — most things are resolved with an email.

16 · The rest

If a clause is unenforceable, the rest survives. Not enforcing something once doesn't waive it. You can't assign this agreement without our consent; we may assign it in a merger or sale. This agreement and the Privacy Policy are the whole understanding between us on this subject.

End of agreement
